headline: HOU @ TOR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is HOU 4.64 at TOR 4.02, with a projected total of 8.66. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward HOU: HOU moved +0.21 runs while TOR moved -0.13, changing the projected margin by +0.34 runs. NRFI probability rose +17.7%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Hunter Brown has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.7 ER over the last 3 outings. Batter research is strongest for Yordan Alvarez, Nathan Lukes, Jeremy Peña, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Brice Matthews, Christian Vázquez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
